nom: Kate Somerville EradiKate Acne Spot Treatment with 10% Sulfur

avis.texte: I have struggled with folliculitis and cystic acne on my collar bones for YEARS, always super painful and never going away. I've used this magic for 4 days and it has cleared up my skin phenomenally, I love this stuff
clears up breakouts so fast!!! do NOT GET IT NEAR YOUR EYES THOUGH !!!!
Does exactly what it says. Ive been breaking out alot on my chin and it helped alot!

Recently I have had tons of acne pop out of nowhere. I think it was hormonal. I tried multiple products and acne would disappear for a day or two and come back. This product helped remove it completely. It is very drying so I was careful to use lots of moisturizer, and I typically only used it when I was inside. I have darker skin and it left a white film when applied.

Definitely needed something for my breakouts and this product was recommended. Will keep using. I love being able to purchase local Ulta products and still get the results I want after using medical grade skincare and switching to more affordable products.
Ugh idk what they changed because this use to be holy grail… so i was excited that it went on sale. But it does not work anymore!
It does and works the same way as calamine lotion — not very effective. For the price point, I think you should save your coins & stick to your tried and true.

This has been my ride or die for years! When I have a big one this zaps it pretty well. I tried other sulfur spot treatments but nothing compares. I do use pimple patches from time to time but this I always have on deck. Do not use on broken skin acne lesions. It contains alcohol and will burn. The smell not so great but Im used to it. Give it go if you can pass the smell.
This stuff made me break out. I gave it a couple of chances, thinking it was a coincidence, and nope. Tossed it (I would have returned it it but I waited a while between tries).

I bought this product, hoping that it would help my hormonal cystic acne, but I just couldn't get past the smell. Given this product contains sulfur, I was expecting it to have an unpleasant odor, but it was just something I couldn't get used to. I only used this product for a few days so I can't speak to overall effectiveness, but I didn't notice any change in my acne in the time that I did use it other than dry skin in the spots that I treated. This is probably better for more surface acne spots so still searching for that holy Grail product.
I've used pimple patches and various spot treatments and nothing compares to Eradikate. It lasts a long time and works quickly on those stubborn, painful zits!

I'm currently going through perimenopause and getting acne because of it. I tried patches, I tried creams, and absolutely nothing works as well as this does! Yes, if you continue to use it once the zit is mostly gone, your skin will dry out. Common sense… Don't abuse your skin once the it is mostly gone! Sometimes it does sting a little at first when you put it on. But literally nothing will clear my skin up faster than this! And I use it directly on zits, or in areas where I'm starting to break out. I absolutely recommend this product!

This product was great at bringing blemishes to a head, but the sulfur smell is really intense. Even after completely washing my face, I could still smell it for hours. I'm keeping it for emergencies, but not regular use.

Incredible product, i have some serious acne a combo of cystic ancne and hormonal acne since i was 15, i am now 26 and have struggled my whole 20s to have nice skin. Nothing has helped excepts laser every month and chemical peels (not cheap) but now This product genuinely helps! Ive been using it for 2 or 3 months and i have it down how i like to use it. In the mornings, I wash my face with the other kate products because I feel like they work so well for me or just a bar of soap and I will take this product dip my Q-tip in the bottom pull it out put it on the back of my palm and put it With my moisturizer and mix it together and I'll put that whole thing on my face and sometimes I'll even layer another layer of just the moisturizer on top and I get so much compliments on my skin because it has that hue to it and it makes your whole face look like one color and it just sinks right into my skin and looks like I have a filter on. I do that every morning and then at night I wash it off or if I do any kind of sweaty activity I wash it off and then I'll do the spot treatment, but sometimes I'll even sleep with it as a mask and it really stepped it up for me the results of my skin cleaning up and every time I wear it in the mornings to work I literally get compliments on how good my skin looks and how it looks so even so, yeah this product will forever be in my house. My skin has cleared up in less yhan two months!! if i feel really dry i skip a day using it. Wish i could share pho

avis.titre: Good formula but not for everyone
avis.texte: I was recommended this product from a friend of mine who said it did wonders for her hormonal acne. However it did quite the opposite for me. Broke me out the worst my skin has ever been in painful cystic acne. If you have incredibly sensitive acne prone/combination skin like I do, please patch test before! Really wish I could've liked this product.
so it does burn a bit and smells like sulfure, but it dramatically reduced a very red and painful pimple I had. worked with 1 use overnight. I can barely see it now. Worth it!

avis.titre: Works for my under the skin acne
avis.texte: I don't typically suffer from black heads or white heads unfortunately I do get under the skin boils which are painful to touch and I find that sulfur works for me so I've been in a hunt for a drying lotion that contains sulfur 10%. No it doesn't smell good but I believe that it's better that there is no fragrance cause my skin is sensitive and fragrance isnt necessary for me personally it dose sting but the results are pretty fast 2 days for me its gone Yes at first I didn't think it was working cause I didn't know you were supposed to use a cotton swab and dip in the pink stuff at the bottom So yeah im a silly goose Obviously its not supposed to be hydrating i mean there is 10% sulfur that's pretty stong stuff there so if your are sensitive to smell then heads up This last me a while now

When I first started using this product, I was pleased with the results- my stubborn, painful acne spots cleared up after 4 days of applying 2 times per day. Then, I realized something… I was applying it wrong. PEOPLE, please be sure to did the cotton swab to the very bottom of the bottle to make sure to get the thicker, more concentrated product. Once I started making sure to actually follow the directions, I saw even better results- pimples cleared up to a small, flaky patch after one overnight application. I went from being sufficiently satisfied to being head over heels in love with this product. If I could give it 6 stars I would. This is hands down the most effective product I have ever used for my acne… and all it took was following the directions. This was a lesson in mindfulness for me lol

This product is amazing! Every single pimple I've gotten has reduced and is almost immediately gone by the next day. Also the redness in my acne has gone away in the three months I've been using this! Will definitely buy again and again

Just bought this product a week ago, was a little skeptical from the reviews but decided to give it a try. I have sensitive skin, didn't give me any bad effects. Smell isn't as strong for me. Did help on my pimples, next day was less visible! :)

avis.titre: good product but a little pricey
avis.texte: def works in helping dry up stubborn pimples. I prefer this to the Mario badescu because of the ingredients. the MB has talc in it, and I don't want that clogging my pores when I'm trying to clear a breakout. to me it's worth the extra $10 for that reason alone.

avis.titre: Used for a month+ each night and no results :(
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this product (especially for the price) but it just does not work for my acne. I typically get whiteheads and deep red papules but this treatment did not improve either of them. My acne looks the same the next morning as it did the night before.

i bought this thinking it would help but it honestly made it worse. i started breaking out in the areas i used it in and my skin got so dry. i only applied it to the areas i needed but i didnt see results. my skin has gotten better without using it😕

Curious to know why I have never used this product before.. Truly, this stuff is amazing! I have very sensitive, very acne prone skin - and sometimes it's the super annoying cystic acne. I have literally been using this product for barely a week and it works WONDERS! Others reviews that it is similar to Calamine lotion, is correct, in smell (which doesn't bother me,) color, and texture. However, it has more ingredients than your typical calamine and it works so well. It dries quickly and layers well with other face products. It's a tiny bottle, but I'm sure it will last a while. Although, I got this on sale, I would easily pay full price for how well this works. Try it out!
I can literally dab this on a bump and the redness is immediately reduced within an hour. Next day results, almost like it never existed.

The product seems to work okay, not the dramatic result i was expecting. it smells awful though. i'm pretty sure that's just how the ingredients smell, but my god. used it and could smell it for hours after removal. would rather use a pimple patch.
Eradikate is undeniably effective, swiftly combating blemishes.

Brought this with the face wash set. This product isn't drying for my skin. I use a Q'tip to dab small amounts on my problem areas and breakouts. I wear this overnight and wake up with smaller problem areas.

I have tried SO many acne spot treatment products over the years and this one is hands down the best! The smell isnt great but it doesnt bother me much anymore once i saw the results I was getting. Dries out blemishes you can feel forming and makes my breakouts so much less worse than they used to be!

I had to come and write this review because I believe this product truly deserves it. I have struggled with horrible acne my entire life & I have never found a spot treatment product that has done anything. This makes them disappear overnight!!
I swear by this product! Almost immediately it clears up my acne, isn't irritating in anyway. I put it on before going to bed after cleansing my face and by the morning it's gone.

My friend recommended this to me after it worked on her skin. It worked for the breakouts on my forehead, but for some odd reason, it make my cheeks even worse. I would wake up with small red breakouts around the pimple I dabbed the product on. Maybe my skin likes being dramatic, but if you have sensitive, dry, & blemish-prone skin like me, use the product with caution.
This is really just overpriced calamine lotion. I am very disappointed I spent money on this when regular calamine is only 5 bucks. Smells HORRID. I leave it on overnight, and the smell lasts…

Finally a spot treament thay WORKS! Ive tried many many different brands. I purchased this during the sale last year and about to purchase again. Even my fiance loves it. Once a week hes asking, "Where is your pink stuff?"
I put the treatment on problematic area every night and it helps my skin so much!

This is my holy grail when it comes to acne! I sucfer from severe hormonal acne and when i get my flate ups, i run straight to this baby! I use it 2-3 nights in a row and my pimple is flat and gone! I have really senstive skin so it does dry out my skin but i moisturize heavily in the morning!
There is nothing to compare to this - if you have a pimple that is forming - put this on RIGHT AWAY! It zaps the zit!

This product works well, but the scent is terrible. I can only use it right as I am going to sleep bc I cant stand the smell. I must change my pillow case the next morning. Other than the smell, the product works,
Love eradikate! Works great on my pimples and the whole family uses it!
I was hesitant to try this because acne spot treatments rarely work, but this product actually works and flattens a pimple in 1-2 days.
I started using this 8 years ago, tried many different spot treatments and I still believe this is the BEST! it does not dry or burn the surrounding skin, but it gets rid of the breakouts.
This was one of the first products I ever ever bought from KS. It's a great go-to for breakouts!
Instead of covering my breakouts with makeup, EradiKate, Acne Treatment removes all of the redness associated with skin eruptions. I am absolutely amazed at how quickly this works.
I love this face mask for when I am having bad acne. Works wonders and has improved my skin so much with regular use!

i've struggled with cystic acne since i was 17 , im 22 now and all those years i've tried literally every spot treatment even some DIY ones ( instant regret) , but this product is my favorite, my pimples were gone within 2 days. when i first used it , i had like 12 dots of spot treatment on my face and now i'm down to only 2 active pimples , i recommend to my friend who also suffers from some acne and she loved it !! it's so relieving how fast and how GOOD this works , 10/10 periodd

Dried up quick! Mostly overnight and then a little bit more over the next few days. But the best part was that it kept the zit from popping and making a scab, so even when it was still present, it was easily covered by makeup. So far so good with this new product.
Totally amazed! This absolutely works and I will never be without a bottle.

avis.titre: Stops huge pimples and breakouts in their tracks
avis.texte: Sulfur is drying, yes but in the case of a huge breakout that starts in a Thursday and you have a big meeting on Monday you NEED this in your warrior skincare tools. It really is a life savior.
This acne treatment is amazing! I've been having bad break outs for the last 3 years. This stuff made it all go away! The bottles are small but they will last a long time.
truly don't know what i would do without this in my life. noticeable improvement on both blemishes & pore size overnight, can be a bit drying though so be careful it if you have dry skin i suppose!
truly don't know what i would do without this in my life. noticeable improvement on both blemishes & pore size overnight, can be a bit drying though so be careful it if you have dry skin i suppose!
you guys it's really works for my acne put it on night time wake up nice and dry. I just love it!!!
Works incredible for whitehead, pimple or pustule based acne. I get small firm mild bumps that leave marks easily & take a long time to heal, takes the redness out but has not faded the marks
This is a life saver !!! A little here helps to reduce acne - overnight with no redness and over drying
Bought this for the 21 DOB and it has worked wonders for my oily/combo skin!
I had a couple nasty blemishes pop up and one was like a little rock under my skin! Well I put this on it overnight and I kid you not they went away. This is my new blemish go to.
Hands down, quickest, most effective acne treatment available! My teen girls and I all use when we get breakouts!
I've struggled with bumps and this cleared them up unless i'm on my period. If you have sensitive skin dont over use you.
I suffer with severe acne and this has been a life saver so many times. i seriously love my eradikate! i've tried many things like it and nothing compares.
I suffer with severe acne and this has been a life saver so many times. i seriously love my eradikate! i've tried many things like it and nothing compares.
I recently bought this amazing product for my teenager but found myself using it just as much as them. I love this product it does miracles for acne and other problematic skin issues.
I love having a spa on treatment, it does seem too dry out some of the really bad sets I have. However, some of the since I get around my jawline don't seem to be affected by this.
I get random breakouts (hormonal), I've tried lots of products but nothing has ever worked this quickly. Used for 2 nights and blemishes where visibly reduced. Amazing.
This really helps clear up whiteheads without over-drying, or leaving a residue the next day.

avis.titre: Derma -E is much better then this Kate Somerville product
avis.texte: I tried the Kate Somerville Eradikate acne treatment since it was a beauty steal at 50% off and the reviews were very positive. This did not work for me. I highly recommended the Derma-E sulfur spot treatment instead. It truly works. My dermatologist suggested using sulfur for my acne caused by daily wearing a mask during Covid. I bought the Derma-E and it worked. I'll stick to using this one and I'll stop brand shopping since I found my solution.
I literally am in love with this acne product! I've been using it for a few years now. Speeds up the healing process of my acne. I have also discovered that it kills cold sores really fast! Amazing!

Def a staple in my skincare routine, helps with surfaced pimples and also with the small bumps on my forehead within a week!! Whenever I get a pimple its gone within 2 days because of this treatment!!
SO GOOD. whiteheads are gone overnight. works better than hydrocolloid patches!
It works really well and helped clear up most of my pimples. Bonus when I finish a bottle I use the left over dry powder as a color corrector during the day.
Just dip your Q tip into the bottle and dab it on your blemishes. They will disappear almost overnight. It's great to keep on hand for the unexpected zit.
I cannot be without this acne treatment! I put it on a blemish at first sign and it rapidly speeds up the clearing process!
Absolutely AMAZING!!! any time i have a pimple even slightly emerging i put a dab on and it's gone by the morning. i tell everyone to buy this!!!
Thus definitely helps to prevents acne from worsening. As soon as I see something I apply this and it keeps things at bay.
I've been using this product for several years. I do use it on problem pimples but also on bug bites. It really seems to help.
This spot treatment works wonders on breakouts without drying out the skin too much! Love this stuff and will always have on hand!

avis.titre: Have been repurchasing for 2+ years and I won't stop!
avis.texte: This is the ONLY product that can take a pimple from a 5 to a 2-even a 1! Tones down redness, brings puss to the surface so you can pop and treat the pimple and if not it just flattens it out underneath the skin! Haven't stopped purchasing it since I first discovered it.
Having a wedding to attend I woke up with raised pimples. Within 30 minutes of applying this spot treatment the flair upside subsided!!!! I was all smiles.

avis.titre: One of my favorite skincare products
avis.texte: This is the best and fastest working acne treatment I have found. Works better than prescription.
Sulfur active ingredient and BHA great to reduce post hyperpigment. Follow directions carefully and really knocks out new emerging acne spots. Also seems to minimize ones already present as well.
This is my favorite product on planet earth. Buying this product was one of the best decisions i've ever made. I would write more but i can't. All i can say is this product is a LIFE saver.
I tried to use this. It smells horrible. It didn't work on any of my spots. I feel like it made it worse.

avis.titre: I bought this wanting to get the Mario B. One!
avis.texte: I'm glad I chose this one over MB one! This works right when you get the first signs of the pimple! I don't like the smell sometimes, but it does the job. I haven't had a pimple resurface on the same spot, so I was very please! I love using the product because you do not shake the bottle, you dip the q tip in, and pull it right out & you can see the clay forming! If you accidentally shake the bottle, let it sit for an hour so all the clay can settle down & the liquid above should be clear.

avis.titre: Dries pretty well, but not perfect
avis.texte: Using for cystic and inflamed red skin. in AM using Kate products cleanser + oil free moisturizer + 2 x per week foaming mask treatment. PM same but with spot treatment. Just ordered anti bac lotion.

I have been using this product for about a month, it is by far the BEST spot treatment I've tried. I have a lot of small breakouts I put this on before bed and wake up and my zits are completely flat!
This product works wonders! I use a q-tip and apply the product to my blemishes and it dries the pimple up so fast!!
This product irritated my skin and did not improve my acne spots at all.

avis.titre: Works on my sensitive oily/combo skin
avis.texte: Great overnight product to calm down breakouts. a little goes a long way
I swear by all the Kate acne products, they are perfect even if you don't have heavy acne. I use this like a toner
After about 2 nights my blemishes were completely gone! Super easy and simple to use daily. Love this product.

I have never experienced so much acne before but once we started wearing masks, my skin has been super reactive. No matter what I do, my skin just hates being under a mask and I breakout often as I have to wear one for work. I've had this for one week and it's amazing how it effectively quiets flare ups! I notice a difference in the morning. It's the one and only thing that's worked for my mask acne so far.
I love using this product on spots with heavy ir deep acne; this covers it up while treating it at the same time. Wonderful product!
Was hesitant at first, but this product is one of a kind! Improves texture and prevents breakouts!
I love this spot treatment! Whenever I get a horribly painful spot I use this at night and wash it off in the morning and the spot is SIGNIFICANTLY smaller, less red and not painful!
Compared to similar products from other companies, this one is very effective and does not dry or flake my skin. I love having an emergency plan for breakouts and this is the one!

I was first taken back by the "Do Not Shake" label on the bottle then I recalled the ingredients. Sulphur and yes, the smell of the product will remind you of its contents BUT ! so not let this pink powerhouse product fool you for one bit. THIS PRODUCT IS AMAZING and works overnight. At 54 I still fight the occasional hideous cystic acne flare up and this is my secret weapon. It has also greatly improved other problem areas on my face. I am so thrilled to of found this product. My advice, it wears on your face like calamine lotion does so use at nighttime and avoid a satin/silk pillowcase. I will buy this again and I highly recommend to all.

Ok I used the Clinique one also but that is BHA not bad. I see some reviews that dont like this one I am just making suggestions. Kate makes the sulfur version. I dont like the smell but if I have pimples popping up this is it. Please apply this after you do all your face regimen at night! There are steps into using this which is not disclosed. Also don't use it on open popped pimples already thats an open wound. Dont shake the bottle. Used a q tip and dip it in till you touch the pink sulfur and then spot. My friends I asked Kate Somerville customer service. I will never live without this product.
I get very nervous about these kinds of products because usually my skin reacts badly and it gets super dry and the blemish is replaced by flaky skin but I haven't had that issue! It worked great!

Picked this up after reading some reviews even though it is fairly expensive. I'm so glad I did and it's worth every penny. Beware it is drying HOWEVER it has blasted away by blemishes AND stopped new pimples in their tracks with less than the recommended applications. I have adult acne and tried many products over the years and found some decent products but this has become my my new holy grail! FYI, smell is unpleasant but it does what it says it does so totally worth it in my opinion.

Works great for those stubborn hormonal pimples and cystic zits that pop up during my monthly cycle. Doesn't always clear them up overnight, but it does reduce this size a lot. Have a had a few stubborn ones on my nose that were too deeply rooted and didn't respond to any treatment, not even this, but it worked well enough for the big ones for me to keep the two bottles I bought on sale. Worth trying out even with sensitive skin, but do a patch test first! It does have alcohol so the mild burning is the main downside.

avis.titre: Beware if you have sensitive skin!!
avis.texte: Looks like Caladryl but smells like rubbing alcohol. I applied it to 3 small places on my face and my face broke out severely, probably 10 times worse than it started out as. It had a reverse effect on me. I would be very cautious if you typically have sensitive skin.

I only bought this because it was part of 21 Days of Beauty and I wasn't happy when it shows up and smelled like nothing but rubbing alcohol. However, I had one stray, cystic breakout out starting on my chin and I was desperate. I applied it before bed and the next day, no exaggeration, it was almost totally flat. It's still healing a few days later, but I skipped a whole week of unpleasantness. With that being said, I'm not saying I would put this all over my face. For spot-application though, I think it works great.

I bought this on the 21 day beauty sale just to try it out. Due to wearing a mask for so long, I've started to get some acne (thought I outgrew that ages ago!). It has helped dry up what I have to where it's barely noticeable, and I haven't had any new breakouts, YAY!!!!

This stuff is amazing. I use it on a q tip as a spot treatment after cleansing and toning before bed, let it dry, then apply moisturizer. The moisturizer keeps my skin from becoming overly dry, and by morning I have no spots. If I use during the day, I apply to a spot before makeup or leave it on if it's covered by a mask. I've only experienced dryness on the healing zits themselves, probably due to moisturizing. I would not recommend smearing this over your whole face or you'll definitely be a flaky snakey a few hours later.
I love this product because it gets rid of the acne spot quickly and reduces redness and inflammation overnight. Great product if you get the random stubborn pimples.

This was a huge NO for me. I have oily skin in the t zone area, and sometimes break out. I don't normally have sensitive skin, but the first time I used this, it made little welts form. These broke open, leaving red scabs on my face which still haven't healed after 5 days. Literally the worst product I've ever used.

Had my eye on this product for about a month. It came up in the 21 Days sale so purchased. Fortuitous timing - my 41 yr old self was brewing a new cystic growth on nose. Product came in, I immediately applied before I went to bed. Unsightly visitor had been banished by the a.m. Did have a slight bit of peeling at application site, but that was much easier to deal with than a red, swollen growth. 6 stars!
I use it every time a small pimple wants to pop out! Usually leave it on throughout the night and in the morning you can see the pimple diminishing.
I use it every time a small pimple wants to pop out! Usually leave it on throughout the night and in the morning you can see the pimple diminishing.
This is a MUST have item for me at all times. Anytime I feel a blemish coming, I apply this with a clean cotton swab. It either eliminates the blemish or significantly speeds up the healing process.
